title: Desktop Autotype Pairing Data Schema
description: The data used in the Pairing and Verification flows for Bitwarden's Autotype implementation must adhere to this schema.

major.description: The major version of the schema this data adheres to.

minor.description: The minor version of the schema this data adheres to.

patch.description: The patch version of the schema this data adheres to.

creationDate.description: The creation date of the pairing, stored as a unix timestamp in seconds since the epoch.

name.description: The readable name of the application paired.

path.description: The normalized absolute path of the application paired, including the file name.

packagingType.description: The type of packaging of the Bitwarden client this pairing was made on. Informs the operating system and potential sandboxing requirements.
